question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party, including dominance over the Politburo and Central Military Commission, underpins the 94.8% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent military leadership purges have aligned top ranks without evident factional opposition, while analyses point to expectations of a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress in late 2027 rather than an abrupt transition. No designated successor has emerged, age-based retirement norms do not apply, and public diplomatic activity continues without signs of internal power struggles or health-related disruptions. Rare scenarios such as sudden illness or elite realignment remain possible but lack supporting evidence in current reporting.
